<div class="card-body">
'''Limited Resources''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">物資の不足</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">敵が手札を2枚以下しか持っていない時に使う。敵は即座に2フォース（こちらのターンなら4フォース）を失う。敵が宇宙船に「融合ジェネレータ供給タンク」を乗せている場合、失うフォースは2減る。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-255o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">帝国は各種資源を軍の統制下においている。倹約につとめる反乱軍だが、補給士官たちが必死で蓄えた緊急用備蓄を吐き出さざるを得ない。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Limited Resources.

'''Card text:''' Use when the opponent has two cards or fewer in hand. The opponent immediately loses 2 Force (4 Force if it is your turn). If the opponent has 融合ジェネレータ供給タンク aboard a starship, the loss is reduced by 2.

'''Lore:''' The Empire keeps resources under military control. The Rebellion is thrifty, but supply officers still have to dump emergency stores.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese names 融合ジェネレータ供給タンク for Fusion Generator Supply Tanks.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Limited Resources]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 99. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
